item.title: Madras High Court orders FIR against Tamil Nadu minister KN Nehru based on ED evidence
item.description: Madras High Court directs the Tamil Nadu Police’s Department of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption to register an FIR against DMK Minister KN Nehru in the Rs 888 crore bribery case related to job appointments in the Municipal Administration and Drinking Water Supply Department.

item.title: US Edge AI package: ₹1800 crore plan for secure AI-ready smartphones in Indo-Pacific
item.description: The US Department of State has launched a competitive process to award up to $200 million (₹1800 crore) to support the rollout of secure, affordable, AI-ready smartphones across Indo-Pacific partner nations. The call invites telcos and OEMs to pitch plans that hit price targets, use trusted Android or iOS, and improve supply chain traceability.

item.title: West Bengal government adds extra egg to students mid-day meal, BJP cries foul
item.description: The West Bengal government has decided to provide eggs and a seasonal fruits to school students under the mid-day meal scheme. The move however faced opposition from the BJP, which termed it as a poll gimmick of Mamata Banerjee’s government and the TMC.

item.title: Trapped students rescued after fire breaks out at Maitrivanam complex in Ameerpet
item.description: Firefighters and police personnel rushed to the spot to rescue students, who sought help from a balcony on the fourth floor.

item.title: Sophie Shine chooses tank top for Mehendi ahead of wedding with Shikhar Dhawan
item.description: Sophie Shine chose a simple tank top for her mehendi ceremony with Shikhar Dhawan, embracing comfort while intricate henna designs were applied ahead of their February wedding. Check the details here.

item.title: Using AI in assessing loan applications: How can it improve credit score?
item.description: Credit scores have long been the most important metric for loan approval in India. However, a very large majority of Indians do not have any credit score. How will a lender access the loan application of such an individual? Well, there is AI to help in the process.

item.title: Rare smooth-coated otters spotted in Uttarakhand’s Nandhaur Sanctuary, signals healthy aquatic ecosystem
item.description: For the first time, smooth-coated otters have been officially recorded in Uttarakhand’s Nandhaur Wildlife Sanctuary. Experts say their presence signals a healthy aquatic ecosystem, as otters thrive only in clean freshwater habitats with strong food chains.

item.title: Mid-day meal row in Mahoba: NHRC takes cognisance of diluted milk video, seeks action-taken report in 2 weeks
item.description: The incident, where children were served water mixed with minimal milk, sparked outrage and led to the head teacher’s suspension. NHRC action highlights violations of children’s fundamental rights to nutrition, demanding accountability and an Action Taken Report from Mahoba authorities within two weeks.

item.title: Goa’s Instagrammable cafe guide: Trendiest dining spots to visit in 2026
item.description: Goa’s café scene gets a stylish upgrade in 2026 with picture-perfect spaces, global flavours and coastal charm. Here are the most Instagrammable spots you simply can’t miss on your next getaway.

item.title: Sikh man allegedly kidnapped from Tracy Gurdwara; US police launch probe
item.description: The San Joaquin County Sheriff’s Office has opened an investigation into the incident, and based on the information they received so far, they have said it’s an isolated incident and ensured there is no threat to the community.
